title: Existence of cochain bifunctor totals from coproducts
statement: For categories A and B with zero morphisms, a preadditive category D with small coproducts, and a bifunctor T:A to (B to D) preserving zero morphisms in both arguments, the total bifunctor exists for any pair P,Q of integer-indexed cochain complexes. In particular this supplies the total tensor existence propositions used in the projection-formula interfaces, without adding a mathematical assumption.

proof.text: The integer-pair fiber over any total degree is small. The given coproducts therefore yield all graded-object coproducts defining the total complex. Apply the existing Mathlib coproduct instance; inferInstance supplies its proof.

lean.statement:
theorem cochainTensorHasMapBifunctor
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [HasZeroMorphisms A]
    {B : Type u} [Category.{v} B] [HasZeroMorphisms B]
    {D : Type u} [Category.{v} D] [Preadditive D] [HasCoproducts.{0} D]
    (T : A ⥤ B ⥤ D) [T.PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    [∀ X, (T.obj X).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (P : CochainComplex A ℤ) (Q : CochainComplex B ℤ) :
    HomologicalComplex.HasMapBifunctor P Q T (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
